captions.detailed: This 3D model represents image-stabilized 10x30 binoculars, styled with a modern, blocky, and ergonomic rubber-armored housing in matte black. It features two thick parallel barrels with blue-tinted optical lenses at both ends, connected by a central hinge system. On top of each barrel is a flat, grey rectangular pad, while the outer sides have ribbed grip patterns. A central focusing mechanism is mounted between the barrels, and a stabilizer switch is located on the side.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of image-stabilized binoculars with a rugged, black rubber-armored housing. The assembly should include two parallel optical barrels with blue lenses, a central revolute hinge connecting them, a central focusing knob, and a stabilizer switch on the outer right body.
captions.factory: The code constructs the binoculars using a multi-part assembly. It defines separate parts for the left barrel, right barrel, and the central bridge. The main barrels are created by combining cylinders and rounded boxes with chamfered edges, with blue-colored circular faces representing the lenses. The central hinge and bridge are modeled using intersecting boxes and cylinders, and are connected to the barrels via revolute joints to simulate folding/adjustment. Flat grey plates on top and ribbed grip blocks on the sides are patterned and fused to the barrel bodies.
